asks.text: The art fetch couldn't bring the folder Approved/Companion-Theme-Backdrops-P1-Complete12-v04 (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/14IhQiRJSyVKuoE3Ji2Rvo1Xi3i8GzAz-). It's 66 MB, and together with the other art it went over the 100 MB limit, so its 12 pictures haven't been…

Do you approve the ten plain dock card backgrounds (Dock-Card-Rarity-Skins-v01)? I suggest approving the colors and the plain middle, and letting the game draw the thin frame and edge marks itself, using your pictures as the guide. That keeps them sharp on a phone.

For the big companion screen, which companion gets which of the 12 scenes? I suggest matching each one by its home, for example wetlands for water beasts, and deciding that when the big screen is built.
Fungal Hollow's background has lettering in the lower left. I suggest making a clean new version without the lettering and putting it in its own new folder in your Artwork Inbox's Approved folder.

Moonlit Grove's background has dark bands across the top and bottom, and Lantern Gloom's has fainter ones. Should they be drawn again without the bands? I suggest yes for Moonlit Grove, and keeping Lantern Gloom until it's seen on the big screen.

Do you approve the see-through pictures of Ashfold, Frostmote, Tackbolt and Brickwarden? They all pass the art check and look clean at small sizes. I suggest approving them if they look right to you. If you'd like, Frostmote could be drawn a little bigger in its picture, so…

What should the masked dagger fighter be called? The ideas so far are Redveil, Duskrunner, Ragblade and Ashknife. I suggest Redveil, because it matches the red scarf and the hidden face. Its game ID is made from the name, so it waits for your choice.

The game's companion pictures are 512×512, but the approved see-through pictures are bigger (1312×1199 or 1254×1254). Is it OK to make a smaller copy of each for the game, without changing anything else in it? I suggest yes. The approved originals would stay untouched in your…

items.title: Replace Tome-tier UI with one permanent numeric Portal progression
items.quote: LOREBOUND — Summoning System UI Refactor. Replace Tome-tier presentation with one permanent Portal progression. This request supersedes earlier Tome-tier UI direction. one permanent Summoning Portal / Rift ... one portal level progression ... Level 1, Level 2, Level 3 ... no Tome I / II / III / IV / V presentation ... no “Library > Tome III” style labeling. This request is primarily a UI / presentation refactor ... preserve current real functionality where possible ... all values displayed are real, live game values.
